LanguageData.Cinder_BurnHemostasis.label: burn hemostasis
LanguageData.Cinder_BurnHemostasis.description: Use burnt tentacles to stop bleeding from wounds on the target's body.
LanguageData.Cinder_SuffocatingWhispers.label: suffocating whispers
LanguageData.Cinder_SuffocatingWhispers.description: Entangles the target with tentacles, causing temporary suffocation and coma.
LanguageData.Cinder_EternalFearAbility.label: eternal fear
LanguageData.Cinder_EternalFearAbility.description: Erodes the spirit of the target, detach it from the protection of reason, and make them fall into the state of fear.
LanguageData.Cinder_FearPulse.label: fear pulse
LanguageData.Cinder_FearPulse.description: Erodes the spirit of nearby animals, causing them to fall into the state of fear.
LanguageData.Cinder_ErosionSkip.label: erosion skip
LanguageData.Cinder_ErosionSkip.description: Forcefully teleporting the target from a location to a random distance, and make them fall into the state of fear. Objects above a certain size cannot be teleported.
LanguageData.Cinder_AmorphousWall.label: amorphous wall
LanguageData.Cinder_AmorphousWall.description: Summon a sturdy tentacle wall from underground.
LanguageData.Cinder_AmorphousIED.label: amorphous IED
LanguageData.Cinder_AmorphousIED.description: Summon a bomb trap from underground, which will automatically reload.
LanguageData.Cinder_AmorphousWinding.label: amorphous winding
LanguageData.Cinder_AmorphousWinding.description: Summon a vast tentacle terrain and entangle anyone walking on it.
LanguageData.Cinder_ErodedBomb.label: eroded bomb
